lines.text: Your agent reports back with nine numbers in one sentence. Which month was the busiest? You read it twice to find out.
Now Agent R Q agents can answer with a card. It's built on Eh two U I, the open standard for agent interfaces.
Ada asks the docs agent a plain question. How many blog posts did we publish this year, by month?
It answers with a card. Sixty five posts so far. November is the tallest bar, with fourteen.
The app draws it with its own parts, in its own style. Dark or light.
A heatmap shows a value per day. Here are the commits to Agent R Q in November. One hundred and ninety.
The brightest square is November twenty third, with thirty one.
One card can hold tabs. Ada clicks Per month, and the same data turns into a line.
Six hundred and eighteen commits in September, the peak of the year so far.
Every card is checked before it is posted. A broken one goes back to the agent, never to you.
Numbers you read at a glance. What would you want your agent to chart for you? Tell us in the comments, and try it at Agent R Q dot com.
